qh: देशव्यापी छात्र बहिष्कारों के दौरान, राष्ट्रीय नियंत्रण के तहत वैकल्पिक शिक्षण विकल्प प्रदान करने के लिए कई प्रमुख राष्ट्रीय शैक्षणिक संस्थान सामने आए। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विश्वविद्यालय इस चरण के दौरान नव स्थापित या विस्तारित किया गया था?
o: Jamia Millia at Aligarh, Kashi Vidyapeeth, Gujarat Vidyapeeth, and Bihar Vidyapeeth
Dayal Singh College at Lahore and Central Hindu College at Benaras exclusively
The Sanskrit College of Calcutta and the Royal Observatory infrastructure
The Bombay Presidency Academic Center and the Fergusson College campus
e: Detailed Explanation: The non-cooperation educational movement led to the creation of several pioneering national universities managed by prominent intellectuals, including Jamia Millia Islamia (initially at Aligarh), Kashi Vidyapeeth, Gujarat Vidyapeeth, and Bihar Vidyapeeth.

qe: Which of the following pairs correctly matches the prominent independent nationalist leader who gave up his lucrative legal practice with his respective region during the spread of the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जोड़ा उस प्रमुख स्वतंत्र राष्ट्रवादी नेता का सही मिलान करता है जिसने असहयोग आंदोलन के प्रसार के दौरान अपने संबंधित क्षेत्र के साथ अपनी आकर्षक कानूनी प्रैक्टिस छोड़ दी थी?
o: Rajendra Prasad — Bihar, and Vallabhbhai Patel — Gujarat
Motilal Nehru — Madras Presidency, and T. Prakasam — Bengal delta
C. Rajagopalachari — Punjab plains, and Saifuddin Kitchlew — Bombay city
Asaf Ali — Assam tea plantations, and C.R. Das — United Provinces
e: Detailed Explanation: During the movement, leading lawyers abandoned their practices to join the struggle. This included Rajendra Prasad in Bihar, Vallabhbhai Patel in Gujarat, Motilal and Jawaharlal Nehru in the United Provinces, C.R. Das in Bengal, and C. Rajagopalachari in Madras.

qe: What significant change occurred in the physical import data parameters of foreign cloth textiles into India as a direct consequence of the public burning and Swadeshi campaigns between 1921 and 1922?
qh: 1921 और 1922 के बीच सार्वजनिक रूप से जलाने और स्वदेशी अभियानों के सीधे परिणाम के रूप में भारत में विदेशी कपड़ों के आयात के आंकड़ों में क्या महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव आया?
o: The value and physical imports of foreign cloth fell by half
The imports of foreign cloth doubled due to industrial factory expansions in Manchester
The import parameters remained completely constant and uniform across all ports
The trade volume dropped to absolute zero within the first week of August 1920
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swadeshi campaign against imported cloth achieved remarkable success. Massive public bonfires of foreign textiles were organized, and the picketing of shops caused the imports of foreign cloth to drop by half between 1920 and 1922.

qe: During the Non-Cooperation Movement, what functional role did the newly emerged 'Congress Volunteer Corps' play across several districts, challenging the colonial state's authority?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान, नवगठित 'कांग्रेस वालंटियर कॉर्प्स' (Congress Volunteer Corps) ने कई जिलों में औपनिवेशिक राज्य के अधिकार को चुनौती देते हुए क्या कार्यात्मक भूमिका निभाई थी?
o: They emerged and operated effectively as a parallel police force to maintain public order
They functioned as direct tax collection intermediaries on behalf of the local district magistrates
They were designed strictly to translate Puranic texts into European languages inside universities
They managed the logistical deployment of British military shipments across coastal ports
e: Detailed Explanation: The non-cooperation agitations weakened local administrative machinery. In many districts, the organized Congress Volunteer Corps stepped into public roles, serving effectively as a parallel police force to manage processions, enforce non-violence, and maintain public order.

qe: What macro-level constitutional or political compromise did the Indian National Congress execute under the 1916 Lucknow Pact that later drew significant criticism from secular economic nationalists?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने 1916 के लखनऊ समझौते के तहत कौन सा बड़ा संवैधानिक या राजनीतिक समझौता किया था, जिसकी बाद में धर्मनिरपेक्ष आर्थिक राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा तीखी आलोचना की गई थी?
o: The formal acceptance of the Muslim League's position on separate electorates and legislative seat weightages
The total legal abolition of the newly consolidated High Court system across presidencies
The direct physical exclusion of women from participating in national educational frameworks
The absolute requirement to pay a metabolic transit duty to support British managing agencies
e: Detailed Explanation: Under the Lucknow Pact of 1916, the Congress formally accepted the principle of separate electorates for Muslims and agreed to a fixed proportion of reserved seats in the legislatures, which critics argue institutionalized communal identities in national politics.

qe: The British Secretary of State for India, Edwin Montagu, issued a historic statement in August 1917. What did this declaration designate as the ultimate long-term goal of British policy in India?
qh: भारत के ब्रिटिश राज्य सचिव एडविन मोंटेग्यू ने अगस्त 1917 में एक ऐतिहासिक बयान जारी किया था। इस घोषणा ने भारत में ब्रिटिश नीति के अंतिम दीर्घकालिक लक्ष्य के रूप में किसे नामित किया था?
o: The progressive realization of responsible self-government for the people of India
The permanent administrative annexation of all independent princely states directly to the Crown
The complete structural termination of any Indian representation inside executive councils
The mandatory introduction of centralized non-competitive allosteric inhibitors inside all schools
e: Detailed Explanation: Pressured by the unified front of the Lucknow Pact and the Home Rule agitation, Edwin Montagu issued the August 1917 Declaration, which officially committed the British government to the gradual development of self-governing institutions and the progressive realization of responsible government in India.

qe: The Royal Commission on Decentralization (1908) made specific structural recommendations to revitalize rural local governance. Which of the following bodies did it suggest should be entrusted with more powers like petty judicial jurisdiction?
qh: रॉयल कमीशन ऑन विकेंद्रीकरण (1908) ने ग्रामीण स्थानीय शासन को पुनर्जीवित करने के लिए विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक सिफारिशें की थीं। इसने निम्नलिखित में से किस निकाय को छोटी न्यायिक अधिकार क्षेत्र जैसी अधिक शक्तियाँ सौंपने का सुझाव दिया था?
o: Village panchayats with adequate sources of income
The centralized Imperial Legislative Council nominees exclusively
The European registrar's courts room attached to Zila courts
The executive committees of the newly established Aligarh School
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1908 Commission emphasized that rural governance should be built from the grass roots. It recommended that village panchayats be revived and endowed with real administrative and petty judicial powers, along with independent sources of income.

qe: Under the judicial hierarchy organized by Lord Cornwallis between 1786 and 1793, what structural change was implemented regarding the traditional District Fauzdari Courts?
qh: 1786 और 1793 के बीच लॉर्ड कॉर्नवॉलिस द्वारा आयोजित न्यायिक पदानुक्रम के तहत, पारंपरिक जिला फौजदारी अदालतों के संबंध में कौन सा संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन लागू किया गया था?
o: They were completely abolished and replaced by provincial Circuit Courts managed by European judges
They were given supreme absolute veto power to override the decisions of the Supreme Council
They were placed under the direct operational command of the local village caste elders
Their jurisdiction was strictly limited to civil property inheritance disputes involving Europeans
e: Detailed Explanation: Lord Cornwallis reformed criminal justice by abolishing the old District Fauzdari Courts, replacing them with four provincial Circuit Courts (at Calcutta, Dacca, Murshidabad, and Patna) presided over by European judges to act as intermediate courts of appeal.

qe: What definitive change did the Government of India Act of 1858 introduce regarding the supervisory control over the administration of India after the dissolution of the East India Company?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1858 ने ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के विघटन के बाद भारत के प्रशासन पर पर्यवेक्षी नियंत्रण के संबंध में क्या निश्चित परिवर्तन किया?
o: The power to govern was transferred to the British Crown, to be wielded through a Secretary of State answerable to the British Parliament
The absolute command of revenues was handed directly to the non-official Indian members of the Legislative Council
The administration was completely subordinated to a newly created Federal Court based in Allahabad
The permanent legal re-establishment of the traditional Mughal legal system under a Deputy Nizam
e: Detailed Explanation: The Act of 1858 dissolved the East India Company and transferred governance directly to the British Crown. This power was exercised through a newly created cabinet post, the Secretary of State for India, who was assisted by a 15-member council and made directly answerable to the British Parliament.

qe: The 'Cornwallis Code' of 1793 established a baseline constitutional milestone in modern Indian administrative history by firmly introducing which major concept?
qh: 1793 के 'कॉर्नवॉलिस कोड' ने किस प्रमुख अवधारणा को दृढ़ता से पेश करके आधुनिक भारतीय प्रशासनिक इतिहास में एक बुनियादी संवैधानिक मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया?
o: The principle of the sovereignty of law and the separation of revenue and justice administration
The absolute legal immunity of all colonial government officials from civil court oversight
The mandatory use of English instead of vernacular languages across all local lower subdivisions
The total structural centralization of all judicial functions under the district Collector
e: Detailed Explanation: The Cornwallis Code of 1793 was a landmark because it established the sovereignty of law and the separation of powers. It separated revenue administration from justice, divested the Collector of judicial duties, and made government officials answerable to civil courts for official actions.

qe: Under the central executive guidelines of the Government of India Act, 1919, what specific bicameral houses replaced the old unicameral Imperial Legislative Council?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1919 के केंद्रीय कार्यकारी दिशानिर्देशों के तहत, किन विशिष्ट द्विसदनीय सदनों ने पुरानी एकसदनीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल का स्थान लिया?
o: The Central Legislative Assembly (lower house) and the Council of State (upper house)
The House of Commons and the House of Lords structural branches
The British Indian Association and the All India Kisan Sabha chambers
The Sadar Diwani Adalat and the Sadar Nizamat legislative divisions
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1919 Act introduced a bicameral central legislature consisting of a lower house named the Central Legislative Assembly and an upper house named the Council of State, introducing the initial structural principle of a double-chamber parliament.

qe: The 'Treaty of Sevres', signed in May 1920 between the Allied powers and Turkey, had what direct impact on the global status of the Ottoman caliphate, deeply incensing Indian Muslims?
qh: मई 1920 में मित्र देशों की शक्तियों और तुर्की के बीच हस्ताक्षरित 'सेवर्स की संधि' (Treaty of Sevres) का ओटोमन खलीफा की वैश्विक स्थिति पर क्या सीधा प्रभाव पड़ा, जिसने भारतीय मुसलमानों को गहरा नाराज कर दिया?
o: It completely dismembered the Ottoman Empire and finalized the removal of the Khalifa from power
It successfully extended the legal control of the Khalifa over all Muslim sacred places globally
It granted absolute sovereign independence to Turkey and its neighboring Arab territories unconditionally
It forced the British Treasury to pay all administrative salaries of the Secretary of State from London funds
e: Detailed Explanation: The Treaty of Sevres completely partitioned and dismembered the Ottoman Empire, stripping the Sultan of Turkey of his territories and removing him from power. This directly targeted the religious status of the Khalifa, which incensed Muslims worldwide and drove the Khilafat agitation into its most militant mass non-cooperation phase.

qe: Following the sudden suspension of the Non-Cooperation Movement, a distinct group of Congress leaders advocated ending the boycott of legislative councils to enter them and obstruct the government. Who spearheaded this school of thought?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के अचानक स्थगन के बाद, कांग्रेस नेताओं के एक विशिष्ट समूह ने विधायी परिषदों का बहिष्कार समाप्त करने, उनमें प्रवेश करने और सरकार को बाधित करने की वकालत की। इस विचारधारा का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
o: C.R. Das, Motilal Nehru, and Ajmal Khan
C. Rajagopalachari, Vallabhbhai Patel, and Rajendra Prasad
Lala Lajpat Rai, Madan Mohan Malaviya, and N.C. Kelkar
Ananda Mohan Bose, Shibchandra Deb, and Umesh Chandra Datta
e: Detailed Explanation: Following Gandhi's arrest in March 1922, the nationalist ranks faced a political vacuum. C.R. Das, Motilal Nehru, and Ajmal Khan advocated entry into the legislative councils to use them as an arena of political struggle, earning the label 'Swarajists'.

qe: The Congress leaders who strongly opposed the proposal of council entry, choosing instead to focus entirely on constructive work and non-cooperation, were historically labeled as:
qh: काउंसिल प्रवेश (council entry) के प्रस्ताव का कड़ा विरोध करने वाले और इसके बजाय पूरी तरह से रचनात्मक कार्य तथा असहयोग पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने वाले कांग्रेस नेताओं को ऐतिहासिक रूप से क्या कहा गया था?
o: The No-Changers
The Responsivists
The Pro-Changers
The Extremists
e: Detailed Explanation: Leaders like C. Rajagopalachari, Vallabhbhai Patel, Rajendra Prasad, and M.A. Ansari opposed entering colonial assemblies. They wanted to continue the boycott and focus on grass-roots constructive work, earning the designation 'No-Changers'.

qe: At which historic annual session of the Indian National Congress in December 1922 was the Swarajist proposal of 'ending or mending' the councils formally defeated, leading to the resignation of C.R. Das?
qh: दिसंबर 1922 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस ऐतिहासिक वार्षिक सत्र में परिषदों को 'समाप्त करने या सुधारने' (ending or mending) के स्वराजवादी प्रस्ताव को औपचारिक रूप से खारिज कर दिया गया था, जिसके कारण सी.आर. दास का इस्तीफा हुआ?
o: The Gaya session
The Surat session
The Nagpur session
The Belgaum session
e: Detailed Explanation: The debate over council entry culminated in a vote at the Gaya session of the INC in December 1922. The No-Changers defeated the council entry proposal, prompting C.R. Das (President) and Motilal Nehru (Secretary) to resign from their official party posts.

qe: Following their defeat at the Gaya session, C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru formally announced the creation of which separate political organization within the broader nationalist front?
qh: गया सत्र में अपनी हार के बाद, सी.आर. दास और मोतीलाल नेहरू ने औपचारिक रूप से व्यापक राष्ट्रवादी मोर्चे के भीतर किस अलग राजनीतिक संगठन के गठन की घोषणा की थी?
o: Congress-Khilafat Swarajya Party
All India Depressed Classes Association
Social Service League
Satyashodhak Labour Front
e: Detailed Explanation: After resigning at the Gaya session, C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru established the Congress-Khilafat Swarajya Party (popularly known as the Swarajist Party) in early 1923, with C.R. Das serving as President and Motilal Nehru as a Secretary.

qe: What primary argument did the Swarajists put forward to justify entering the colonial legislative assemblies during a phase of mass passivity?
qh: जन निष्क्रियता के चरण के दौरान औपनिवेशिक विधायी विधानसभाओं में प्रवेश को सही ठहराने के लिए स्वराजवादियों ने कौन सा प्राथमिक तर्क दिया था?
o: It would open a new front to prevent undesirable elements from stuffing the councils and providing false legitimacy to government measures
It would allow them to permanently transfer the central portfolio finance to local village panchayats
It would completely dissolve the separate communal electorates introduced under the Morley-Minto reforms
It would enable them to replace the entire permanent civil bureaucracy with Indian officers within a year
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swarajists argued that entering councils was a continuation of non-cooperation by other means. It would keep up public morale during a political vacuum and block pro-government loyalists from occupying seats to legitimize arbitrary state laws.

qe: The No-Changers fiercely criticized parliamentary work, arguing that entering the assemblies would directly cause which negative development within the nationalist ranks?
qh: नो-चेंजर्स (No-Changers) ने संसदीय कार्य की तीखी आलोचना की, यह तर्क देते हुए कि विधानसभाओं में प्रवेश करने से राष्ट्रवादी रैंकों के भीतर कौन सा नकारात्मक विकास होगा?
o: Neglect of grass-roots constructive work, loss of revolutionary zeal, and political corruption
The immediate and complete financial bankruptcy of the Tilak Swaraj Fund
The total structural dissolution of all rural ashrams operating across Gujarat
Forcing the central working committee to adopt violent guerrilla parameter tactics
e: Detailed Explanation: The No-Changers maintained that entry into colonial legislatures would distract cadres from grass-roots organizing, erode their revolutionary fervor, and expose nationalist representatives to the perks, privileges, and political corruption of office.

qe: To avoid a damaging split like the one in 1907, both factions maintained coordination and reached a formal compromise at a meeting in Delhi in September 1923. What did this compromise allow?
qh: 1907 की तरह एक विनाशकारी विभाजन से बचने के लिए, दोनों गुटों ने समन्वय बनाए रखा और सितंबर 1923 में दिल्ली में एक बैठक में औपचारिक समझौता किया। इस समझौते ने क्या अनुमति दी?
o: The Swarajists were allowed to contest the upcoming elections as a distinct political group within the Congress
The absolute dissolution of the No-Changers' constructive work ashrams across Kheda and Bardoli
The mandatory appointment of Mahatma Gandhi as the permanent executive judge of the Zila Courts
A complete legislative termination of the separate communal electorates framework entirely
e: Detailed Explanation: Recognizing the need for unity under Gandhi's leadership, a compromise was struck in Delhi in September 1923. The Swarajists were officially permitted to contest the upcoming November 1923 elections as a distinct group operating within the Congress infrastructure.

qe: The official Swarajist Manifesto, released in October 1923, took a sharp anti-imperialist line. What tactical strategy did it outline if the government rejected their nationalist demands inside the councils?
qh: अक्टूबर 1923 में जारी आधिकारिक स्वराजवादी घोषणापत्र (Swarajist Manifesto) ने एक तीखा साम्राज्यवादी विरोधी रुख अपनाया। यदि सरकार ने परिषदों के भीतर उनकी राष्ट्रवादी मांगों को खारिज कर दिया, तो इसमें किस रणनीति की रूपरेखा दी गई थी?
o: A policy of uniform, continuous, and consistent obstruction within the councils to wreck them from within by creating deadlocks
The immediate physical burning of all municipal registration records across the United Provinces
Filing joint property lawsuits before a special three-judge panel of the High Court room
Directly ordering the working class to execute violent arsenal strikes across the Punjab plains
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swarajist election manifesto stated that they would present a demand for self-government inside the councils. If rejected, they vowed to execute a policy of uniform, continuous, and consistent obstruction to create legislative deadlocks and wreck the councils from within.

qe: In the general elections of November 1923, how many total elected seats did the Swarajists manage to secure within the Central Legislative Assembly, reflecting their significant electoral success?
qh: नवंबर 1923 के आम चुनावों में, स्वराजवादियों ने केंद्रीय विधानसभा के भीतर कुल कितनी चुनी हुई सीटों पर जीत हासिल की, जो उनकी महत्वपूर्ण चुनावी सफलता को दर्शाती है?
o: 42 out of 141 elected seats
72 out of 145 elected seats
15 out of 60 elected seats
45 out of 69 elected seats
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swarajist Party performed remarkably well in the November 1923 elections, capturing exactly 42 out of 141 elected seats in the central Imperial Legislative Council and a clear majority in the Central Provinces assembly.

qe: To win legislative majorities on critical political questions inside the Central Legislative Assembly, the Swarajists formed strategic coalitions with which other groups?
qh: केंद्रीय विधानसभा के भीतर महत्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक प्रश्नों पर विधायी बहुमत हासिल करने के लिए, स्वराजवादियों ने किन अन्य समूहों के साथ रणनीतिक गठबंधन बनाया?
o: The Liberals and independent members like Jinnah and Malaviya
The orthodox ulema of the Deoband School and the Faraizi commanders
The conservative pro-landlord elements of the Dharma Sabha coalition
The radical Derozian student network attached to the Hindu College
e: Detailed Explanation: Though they lacked an absolute majority on their own in the Central Assembly, the Swarajists successfully outvoted the government by forging strategic alliances and coalitions with Moderate Liberals and prominent independents like Mohammad Ali Jinnah and Madan Mohan Malaviya.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi historically presided over an annual session of the Indian National Congress only once. At which session did this occur, formally endorsing the agreement that the Swarajists would function as an integral part of the Congress?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने ऐतिहासिक रूप से केवल एक बार भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के वार्षिक सत्र की अध्यक्षता की थी। यह किस सत्र में हुआ था, जिसमें औपचारिक रूप से इस समझौते का समर्थन किया गया था कि स्वराजवादी कांग्रेस के एक अभिन्न अंग के रूप में कार्य करेंगे?
o: The Belgaum session of December 1924
The Gaya session of December 1922
The Surat split conference of December 1907
The Nagpur structural reorganization session of December 1920
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi presided over the Congress only once—at the Belgaum session in December 1924. This session formally ratified the compromise between the two wings, integrating the Swarajists as the parliamentary front of the Congress.

qe: During the mid-1920s, the internal unity of the Swarajist Party fractured along a communal and strategic divide. What were the two competing camps that emerged within the party?
qh: 1920 के दशक के मध्य के दौरान, स्वराजवादी पार्टी की आंतरिक एकता सांप्रदायिक और रणनीतिक विभाजन के कारण टूट गई। पार्टी के भीतर उभरने वाले दो प्रतिस्पर्धी खेमे कौन से थे?
o: The Responsivists and the Non-responsivists
The Moderates and the Extremists structural wings
The Atmiya Sabha and the Dharma Sabha coalitions
The Akali satyagrahis and the Udasi mahant loyalists
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swarajist front fractured into two camps: the 'Responsivists', who favored cooperating with the government to hold offices and protect Hindu interests, and the main leadership ('Non-responsivists'), who rejected government posts and stuck to obstructionist lines.

qe: Who among the following Swarajist leaders spearheaded the 'Responsivist' faction, advocating for cooperation with the colonial government and holding office wherever possible?
qh: निम्नलिखित स्वराजवादी नेताओं में से किसने 'उत्तरदायी' (Responsivist) गुट का नेतृत्व किया, जिसने औपनिवेशिक सरकार के साथ सहयोग करने और जहाँ भी संभव हो पद संभालने की वकालत की?
o: Lala Lajpat Rai, Madan Mohan Malaviya, and N.C. Kelkar
Motilal Nehru, C.R. Das, and Ajmal Khan exclusively
C. Rajagopalachari, Vallabhbhai Patel, and M.A. Ansari
Ananda Mohan Bose, Shibchandra Deb, and Umesh Chandra Datta
e: Detailed Explanation: Following the death of C.R. Das in 1925, the Responsivist faction within the Swarajists emerged under Lala Lajpat Rai, Madan Mohan Malaviya, and N.C. Kelkar, who shifted away from total obstruction to protect what they defined as Hindu interests.

qe: The Swarajist position in Bengal was severely weakened, and they lost the vital baseline support of many Muslim members. What specific policy failure caused this political alienation?
qh: बंगाल में स्वराजवादियों की स्थिति गंभीर रूप से कमजोर हो गई थी, और उन्होंने कई मुस्लिम सदस्यों का महत्वपूर्ण आधार समर्थन खो दिया। किस विशिष्ट नीतिगत विफलता के कारण यह राजनीतिक अलगाव हुआ?
o: The party failed to support the tenants' cause against the oppressive zamindars in Bengal
They actively voted to implement high export tariffs on native raw jute shipments
The leadership completely refused to establish any national schools inside the Dacca municipality
They introduced a formal resolution demanding the compulsory use of English inside village courts
e: Detailed Explanation: In Bengal, the majority of agricultural tenants were Muslim, while the zamindars were predominantly Hindu. When the Swarajist Party chose not to support pro-tenant legislation against the zamindars, they alienated the Muslim peasantry and lost the backing of Muslim legislators.

qe: In March 1926, the main leadership of the Swarajist Party withdrew from the legislatures. What program did they reiterate their faith in at this juncture?
qh: मार्च 1926 में, स्वराजवादी पार्टी के मुख्य नेतृत्व ने विधानसभाओं से अपना नाम वापस ले लिया। इस मोड़ पर उन्होंने किस कार्यक्रम में अपना विश्वास दोहराया?
o: Mass civil disobedience
Constitutional petitioning via the Dharma Sabha
The complete acceptance of the separate electorates framework
The absolute preservation of the status quo under British rule
e: Detailed Explanation: Recognizing that their obstructionist tactics had limits and the party was fragmenting, the main Swarajist leadership under Motilal Nehru walked out of the legislatures in March 1926, re-emphasizing their faith in a future campaign of mass civil disobedience.

qe: What final dynamic event in 1930 caused the remaining Swarajist members to permanently walk out of all colonial legislative assemblies?
qh: 1930 में किस अंतिम गतिशील घटना के कारण शेष स्वराजवादी सदस्यों ने सभी औपनिवेशिक विधायी विधानसभाओं से स्थायी रूप से वॉकआउट कर दिया?
o: The Lahore Congress resolution on Purna Swaraj and the beginning of the Civil Disobedience Movement
The sudden, formal enactment of the Public Safety Bill by a viceroy's ordinance
The absolute legal consolidation of the separate electorates under the Indian Councils Act
The signing of the Treaty of Sevres that completely dismembered the Ottoman caliphate
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swarajist parliamentary experiment ended permanently in 1930. Following the historic Lahore Congress resolution that declared Purna Swaraj (complete independence) as the national goal and launched the Civil Disobedience Movement, all Swarajist legislators resigned from their seats.

qe: Which prominent Swarajist leader achieved a major constitutional milestone in 1825 by being elected as the very first Indian Speaker (President) of the central Legislative Assembly?
qh: किस प्रमुख स्वराजवादी नेता ने 1925 में केंद्रीय विधानसभा के पहले भारतीय अध्यक्ष (Speaker) के रूप में चुने जाने के बाद एक प्रमुख संवैधानिक मील का पत्थर हासिल किया था?
o: Vithalbhai Patel
Motilal Nehru
C.R. Das
Rashbehari Ghosh
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1825, the Swarajists scored a major institutional victory when Vithalbhai Patel (brother of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) was successfully elected as the first Indian Speaker (President) of the Central Legislative Assembly.

qe: In 1928, the Swarajists successfully coordinated a historic legislative defeat against which repressive government Bill that aimed to empower the state to deport foreigners?
qh: 1928 में, स्वराजवादियों ने किस दमनकारी सरकारी विधेयक (Bill) के खिलाफ एक ऐतिहासिक विधायी हार का सफलतापूर्वक समन्वय किया, जिसका उद्देश्य राज्य को विदेशियों को निर्वासित करने का अधिकार देना था?
o: Public Safety Bill
Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Bill
Seditious Meetings Restriction Bill
Indian Newspapers Registration Act
e: Detailed Explanation: Alarmed by the spread of socialist and communist ideas via international activists, the government introduced the Public Safety Bill in 1928 to deport targeted foreigners. The Swarajists and their coalition partners defeated this repressive bill in the assembly.

qe: From an analytical perspective, what primary structural drawback characterized the Swarajist strategy inside the legislative assemblies?
qh: विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण से, विधायी विधानसभाओं के भीतर स्वराजवादी रणनीति की मुख्य संरचनात्मक कमी क्या थी?
o: They lacked a clear policy to coordinate their militancy inside legislatures with the mass struggle outside
They completely refused to participate in any budget debate or move adjournment motions
They were financially dependent on the credit lines managed by British managing agencies
They rejected any political cooperation with independent legislators like Jinnah and Malaviya
e: Detailed Explanation: A major drawback of the Swarajists was their isolation from grass-roots organizing. They failed to coordinate their parliamentary opposition inside the councils with an active mass movement outside, relying almost entirely on newspapers to communicate with the public.

qe: The No-Changers dedicated themselves entirely to grass-roots constructive work during the transition phase. In which specific geographical areas of Gujarat did their ashrams become highly successful hubs?
qh: नो-चेंजर्स ने संक्रमण चरण के दौरान खुद को पूरी तरह से जमीनी स्तर के रचनात्मक कार्यों के लिए समर्पित कर दिया। गुजरात के किन विशिष्ट भौगोलिक क्षेत्रों में उनके आश्रम अत्यधिक सफल केंद्र बने?
o: Kheda and Bardoli areas
Surat and Ahmedabad municipal zones
Barisal subdivisions
Midnapore and Guntur plains
e: Detailed Explanation: The No-Changers set up a network of rural ashrams, which became highly active in the Kheda and Bardoli districts of Gujarat. Young volunteers lived among tribals and lower-caste communities, popularizing the charkha and weaving khadi.

qe: What vital role did the grass-roots constructive workers of the No-Changers eventually serve when the national movement transitioned back into an active phase of struggle?
qh: जब राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन वापस संघर्ष के एक सक्रिय चरण में बदल गया, तो नो-चेंजर्स के जमीनी स्तर के रचनात्मक कार्यकर्ताओं ने अंततः क्या महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई?
o: They served as the organizational backbone and active organizers of civil disobedience
They were transformed into the chief executive judges of the newly consolidated High Courts
They managed the collection of land revenue shares on behalf of the district collectors
They organized a complete mass migration of the urban lower middle classes toward London
e: Detailed Explanation: Though often criticized as passive, the constructive work done by the No-Changers maintained connections with the masses during the quiet phase. These dedicated grass-roots cadres served as the organizational backbone when the next phase of the Civil Disobedience Movement was launched.

qe: A critical evaluation of the national education schools set up by the No-Changers shows that they suffered from a structural limitation during the passive phase. What was this limitation?
qh: नो-चेंजर्स द्वारा स्थापित राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा स्कूलों के एक आलोचनात्मक मूल्यांकन से पता चलता है कि वे निष्क्रिय चरण के दौरान एक संरचनात्मक सीमा से पीड़ित थे। यह सीमा क्या थी?
o: The lure of degrees and official jobs eventually drew students back to colonial schools and colleges during periods of passivity
The schools were completely banned from using local vernacular languages as the medium of instruction
They were financially dependent on the grants-in-aid provided by the Royal Commission on Decentralization
The infrastructure was restricted exclusively to the landless agricultural untouchable laborers
e: Detailed Explanation: National education institutions flourished during the excitement of the mass movement. However, during the quiet passive phase, the long-term lure of official degrees and government jobs inevitably drew students back to government-controlled schools and colleges.

qe: What was a major operational hurdle faced by the No-Changers when attempting to popularize the use of Khadi among the poor subsistence peasantry?
qh: गरीब किसानों के बीच खादी के उपयोग को लोकप्रिय बनाने का प्रयास करते समय नो-चेंजर्स द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली एक बड़ी परिचालन बाधा क्या थी?
o: Khadi was significantly costlier than the mass-imported machine-made British cloth
The colonial government passed an ordinance making the spinning of yarn a criminal capital offense
The use of the charkha was strictly restricted by upper castes to religious festivals exclusively
Khadi cloth was chemically unstable under the ambient temperature parameters of local villages
e: Detailed Explanation: While ideologically powerful, popularizing Khadi was difficult because hand-spun Khadi was significantly costlier than the cheap, mass-produced machine-made textile imports flooding the market from Manchester.

qe: Critics note that while campaigning heavily against the social stigma of untouchability, the constructive work framework of the No-Changers failed to address which critical dimension?
qh: आलोचक ध्यान देते हैं कि अस्पृश्यता के सामाजिक कलंक के खिलाफ भारी अभियान चलाने के बावजूद, नो-चेंजर्स का रचनात्मक कार्य ढांचा किस महत्वपूर्ण आयाम को संबोधित करने में विफल रहा?
o: The specific economic grievances of the landless and agricultural laborers who comprised the bulk of the untouchables
The mandatory registration of lower-caste births inside the provincial legislative councils
The direct translation of traditional Puranic scriptures into local regional vernacular mediums
Providing separate electoral colleges for the intermediate non-Brahmin communities inside Mysore
e: Detailed Explanation: A major structural critique of the No-Changers' social reform campaign was its focus on the moral and social aspects of untouchability (like temple entry or temple cleanliness) while ignoring the underlying economic grievances of the landless Dalit agricultural laborers.

qe: A survey tracking route plots a right-angled triangular configuration from depot O. A vehicle moves 24 km North, and then shifts orientation to drive 10 km East to reach target point B. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक कार डिपो O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 10 किमी जाकर बिंदु B पर पहुँचती है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 26 km
34 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement tracks a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs measuring 24 km and 10 km. The direct straight-line distance is the hypotenuse.
Applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 10^2} = \sqrt{576 + 100} = \sqrt{676} = \mathbf{26\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological ecosystem study tracking energy metrics, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of a forest tract is measured at 45,000 units and the energy accumulated as Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 25,000 units, calculate the energy spent during plant metabolic respiration (R).
qh: ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक वन क्षेत्र की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 45,000 इकाइयाँ है और शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) के रूप में संचित ऊर्जा 25,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
70,000 units
30,000 units
15,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological relationship formula: $NPP = GPP - R$, we isolate respiration losses: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the given numbers: $R = 45,000 - 25,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: The 'Congress-Khilafat Swarajya Party' was established with C.R. Das as its permanent President. Who among its co-founders was appointed as one of its chief Secretaries?
qh: सी.आर. दास के स्थायी अध्यक्ष के रूप में 'कांग्रेस-खिलाफत स्वराज्या पार्टी' की स्थापना की गई थी। इसके सह-संस्थापकों में से किसे इसके मुख्य सचिवों में से एक के रूप में नियुक्त किया गया था?
o: Motilal Nehru
Ajmal Khan
C. Riveragopalachari
Vithalbhai Patel
e: Detailed Explanation: Following their resignation from official Congress posts at the Gaya session, the Swarajist Party was organized with Chittaranjan Das (C.R. Das) as President and Pandit Motilal Nehru serving as one of its chief secretaries.

qe: Rethinking political avenues, what did the main leadership of the Swarajists identify as the true operational purpose of entering the colonial legislative assemblies?
qh: राजनीतिक मार्गों पर पुनर्विचार करते हुए, स्वराजवादियों के मुख्य नेतृत्व ने औपनिवेशिक विधायी विधानसभाओं में प्रवेश करने के वास्तविक परिचालन उद्देश्य के रूप में क्या पहचान की थी?
o: To use the councils as an arena of political struggle to expose their basic weaknesses and arouse popular enthusiasm from within
To cooperate fully with British managing agencies to maximize foreign capital investments
To provide legal defense counsel tracking to revolutionary terrorists facing sedition charges
To gradually transform the colonial administrative rules into a national rule through step-by-step constitutional bills
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swarajists had no intention of using the assemblies to gradually transform colonial rule. They viewed council entry as a tactical move to open a new political front, expose the weaknesses of the Montford scheme, and use the chambers as an arena of struggle to maintain public morale.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi initially opposed the Swarajist proposal of council entry upon his release from prison in February 1924. What primary factor later convinced him to reconcile and accommodate their wishes?
qh: फरवरी 1924 में जेल से रिहा होने पर महात्मा गांधी ने शुरू में स्वराजवादी परिषद प्रवेश के प्रस्ताव का विरोध किया था। बाद में किस प्राथमिक कारक ने उन्हें उनके साथ समझौता करने और उनकी इच्छाओं को स्वीकार करने के लिए आश्वस्त किया?
o: The courageous, uncompromising manner in which the Swarajists functioned in the legislatures, combined with a severe government crackdown on them and revolutionary groups in late 1924
The Swarajists voluntarily agreed to dissolve their party infrastructure and abandon council work permanently
The passing of the Public Safety Bill by a thumping majority inside the Central Legislative Assembly
A massive influx of Muslim peasant members into the regional branches of the Swarajist party in Bengal
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi changed his stance for two reasons: the Swarajists' disciplined, uncompromising performance in the legislatures proved they would not become tools of the bureaucracy, and a late 1924 government crackdown on both the Swarajists and revolutionaries prompted Gandhi to show solidarity by backing them.

qe: Following the breakdown of talks between Mahatma Gandhi and Viceroy Lord Reading in May 1921, the colonial state launched a severe crackdown. What defensive measure did the government execute to legally paralyze the nationalist volunteers?
qh: मई 1921 में महात्मा गांधी और वायसराय लॉर्ड रीडिंग के बीच बातचीत विफल होने के बाद, औपनिवेशिक राज्य ने कड़ी कार्रवाई शुरू की। स्वयंसेवकों को कानूनी रूप से पंगु बनाने के लिए सरकार ने कौन सा रक्षात्मक कदम उठाया?
o: Volunteer corps were declared illegal, public meetings were banned, and the press was gagged
The state passed a summary decree nationalizing all private property assets held by the Gujarat Vidyapeeth
The administration completely abolished the separate central and provincial list classifications
The judiciary forced all arrested political workers to undergo manual labor inside the local arsenal workshops
e: Detailed Explanation: In late 1921, as the Non-Cooperation Movement intensified, the colonial government resorted to severe repression. They outlawed all Congress and Khilafat volunteer corps, banned public assemblies, imposed strict censorship on the press, and jailed thousands of activists.

qe: The landmark Indian Councils Act of 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms) introduced a highly controversial institutional mechanism that deeply damaged national unity. What was this mechanism?
qh: 1909 के ऐतिहासिक भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम (मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधार) ने एक अत्यधिक विवादास्पद संस्थागत तंत्र पेश किया जिसने राष्ट्रीय एकता को गहरा नुकसान पहुँचाया। यह तंत्र क्या था?
o: The establishment of separate electorates for Muslims for election to the Central Council
The total legal abolition of all native vernacular media publications across codes
The absolute non-cooperation framework barring any Indian from entering the civil services
The direct physical takeover of all village community water solutions by British managing agencies
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Councils Act of 1909 introduced separate electorates for Muslims for the first time. This institutionalized communal voting, creating deep socio-political barriers that checked the growth of national unity.

qe: Under the structural mechanics of Dyarchy introduced by the Government of India Act 1919 at the provincial level, how were the administrative subjects systematically divided?
qh: प्रांतीय स्तर पर भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 द्वारा शुरू किए गए द्वैध शासन (Dyarchy) के संरचनात्मक तंत्र के तहत, प्रशासनिक विषयों को व्यवस्थित रूप से कैसे विभाजित किया गया था?
o: Into 'Reserved' subjects (like law and order, finance) and 'Transferred' subjects (like education, health)
Into central maritime trading licenses and local sub-infeudation land lists
Into exclusive religious shastra portfolios and secular judicial codes
Into non-votable military expenditures and open external export duty limits
e: Detailed Explanation: Dyarchy split provincial subjects into two lists: 'Reserved' subjects (law and order, finance, land revenue, irrigation) kept under bureaucratic control; and 'Transferred' subjects (education, health, local government, agriculture) allocated to Indian popular ministers.

qe: The 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' introduced a profound constitutional shift in the administration of the sub-continent by:
qh: ऐतिहासिक 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' ने उपमहाद्वीप के प्रशासन में कौन सा गहरा संवैधानिक बदलाव पेश किया?
o: Transferring the power to govern from the East India Company directly to the British Crown, to be wielded through a Secretary of State
Establishing complete provincial autonomy under popular native ministerial portfolios
Abolishing the office of the Viceroy and creating the separate Federal Court structure
Scrapping the supervisory control of the British Parliament over Indian revenues
e: Detailed Explanation: Following the 1857 Revolt, the Act of 1858 dissolved the East India Company. It transferred the sovereign power to govern India directly to the British Crown, to be exercised through a cabinet post, the Secretary of State for India.

qe: The judicial framework of the Cornwallis Code of 1793 established a major milestone in modern Indian administrative history by firmly introducing which concept?
qh: 1793 के कॉर्नवॉलिस कोड के न्यायिक ढांचे ने किस अवधारणा को दृढ़ता से पेश करके आधुनिक भारतीय प्रशासनिक इतिहास में एक बुनियादी मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया?
o: The principle of the sovereignty of law and the separation of revenue and justice administration
The absolute legal immunity of all colonial government officials from civil court oversight
The mandatory use of English instead of vernacular languages across all local lower subdivisions
The total structural centralization of all judicial functions under the district Collector
e: Detailed Explanation: The Cornwallis Code of 1793 was a landmark because it established the sovereignty of law and the separation of powers. It separated revenue administration from justice, divested the Collector of judicial duties, and made government officials answerable to civil courts for official actions.

qe: The 'Treaty of Sevres', signed in May 1920 between the Allied powers and Turkey, had what direct impact on the global status of the Ottoman caliphate, deeply incensing Indian Muslims?
qh: मई 1920 में मित्र देशों की शक्तियों और तुर्की के बीच हस्ताक्षरित 'सेवर्स की संधि' (Treaty of Sevres) का ओटोमन खलीफा की वैश्विक स्थिति पर क्या सीधा प्रभाव पड़ा, जिसने भारतीय मुसलमानों को गहरा नाराज कर दिया?
o: It completely dismembered the Ottoman Empire and finalized the removal of the Khalifa from power
It successfully extended the legal control of the Khalifa over all Muslim sacred places globally
It granted absolute sovereign independence to Turkey and its neighboring Arab territories unconditionally
It forced the British Treasury to pay all administrative salaries of the Secretary of State from London funds
e: Detailed Explanation: The Treaty of Sevres completely partitioned and dismembered the Ottoman Empire, stripping the Sultan of Turkey of his territories and removing him from power. This directly targeted the religious status of the Khalifa, which incensed Muslims worldwide and drove the Khilafat agitation into its mass non-cooperation phase.

qe: The Government of India Act, 1919 contained a statutory provision for appointing a review commission ten years from its date of enactment. Which British Prime Minister prematurely constituted this seven-member commission in November 1927?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1919 में इसके अधिनियमन की तारीख से दस वर्ष बाद एक समीक्षा आयोग नियुक्त करने का वैधानिक प्रावधान शामिल था। किस ब्रिटिश प्रधानमंत्री ने नवंबर 1927 में समय से पहले इस सात सदस्यीय आयोग का गठन किया था?
o: Stanley Baldwin
Winston Churchill
John Morley
Ramsay MacDonald
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Statutory Commission, popularly known as the Simon Commission, was prematurely appointed on November 8, 1927, by British Prime Minister Stanley Baldwin to prevent the crucial question of Indian constitutional reforms from falling into the hands of the opposition Labour Party.

qe: By the mid-1920s, the unworkable nature of Dyarchy led to various inquiries. Which specific colonial commission investigated the critical failure of the Raj to recruit an adequate number of British officers for the administrative services?
qh: 1920 के दशक के मध्य तक, द्वैध शासन (Dyarchy) की अव्यवहारिक प्रकृति के कारण विभिन्न जाँचें हुईं। किस विशिष्ट औपनिवेशिक आयोग ने प्रशासनिक सेवाओं के लिए पर्याप्त संख्या में ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों की भर्ती करने में राज की विफलता की जाँच की थी?
o: The Lee Commission
The Muddiman Commission
The Linlithgow Commission
The Rowlatt Commission
e: Detailed Explanation: In the mid-1920s, several reports evaluated the 1919 Act. The Lee Commission specifically investigated the failure to recruit sufficient British officers for the imperial administrative services, while Muddiman looked into diarchic deadlocks and Linlithgow into agriculture.

qe: Which Conservative Secretary of State for India was responsible for appointing the Simon Commission, frequently taunting Indian politicians for their alleged inability to draft an agreed constitutional scheme?
qh: भारत के लिए कौन सा कंजर्वेटिव राज्य सचिव (Secretary of State) साइमन आयोग की नियुक्ति के लिए जिम्मेदार था, जो अक्सर भारतीय राजनेताओं को एक सहमत संवैधानिक योजना तैयार करने में उनकी कथित असमर्थता के लिए ताना मारता था?
o: Lord Birkenhead
Edwin Montagu
John Morley
Viceroy Lord Minto
e: Detailed Explanation: Lord Birkenhead, the Conservative Secretary of State for India, masterminded the appointment of the all-white Simon Commission. He constantly taunted Indians, claiming they were incapable of formulating a concrete constitutional plan supported by wide sections of local political opinion.

qe: What primary intellectual and political grievance unified almost all Indian factions to immediately boycott and oppose the Indian Statutory Commission upon its announcement in 1927?
qh: 1927 में भारतीय वैधानिक आयोग (Simon Commission) की घोषणा के बाद लगभग सभी भारतीय गुटों को तुरंत इसका बहिष्कार और विरोध करने के लिए किस प्राथमिक बौद्धिक और राजनीतिक शिकायत ने एकजुट किया था?
o: The complete exclusion of Indians from the commission and the underlying notion that foreigners would judge India's fitness for self-government
The mandatory requirement to enforce English-only education codes across all rural ashrams
The total legal abolition of the separate communal electorates allocated to non-Asian foreign settlers
The dynamic implementation of a metabolic tax surcharge on all native cotton textile mills
e: Detailed Explanation: The exclusion of Indians from an all-white commission tasking with deciding India's constitutional future was seen as a deliberate insult to national self-respect and a blatant violation of the principle of self-determination, triggering immediate and nearly unanimous opposition.

qe: The Indian National Congress formally resolved to boycott the Simon Commission 'at every stage and in every form' during its December 1927 annual session. Where was this historic session hosted, and who presided over it?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने दिसंबर 1927 के अपने वार्षिक सत्र के दौरान साइमन आयोग का 'हर स्तर पर और हर रूप में' बहिष्कार करने का औपचारिक प्रस्ताव पारित किया। यह ऐतिहासिक सत्र कहाँ आयोजित किया गया था, और इसकी अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
o: The Madras session under Dr. M.A. Ansari
The Calcutta session under Dadabhai Naoroji
The Nagpur session under W.C. Bonnerjee
The Belgaum session under Mahatma Gandhi
e: Detailed Explanation: The Congress met in a highly charged atmosphere at Madras in December 1927 under the presidency of Dr. M.A. Ansari. The session resolved to completely boycott the Simon Commission and passed a snap resolution declaring complete independence as the ultimate goal.

qe: The announcement of the Simon Commission fractured the All India Muslim League into two competing factions in 1927. Which faction decided to oppose the commission, and where did they convene?
qh: साइमन कमीशन की घोषणा ने 1927 में अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग को दो प्रतिस्पर्धी गुटों में विभाजित कर दिया। किस गुट ने आयोग का विरोध करने का निर्णय लिया और वे कहाँ एकत्र हुए?
o: The faction under Mohammad Ali Jinnah at Calcutta
The faction under Muhammad Shafi at Lahore
The Aligarh conservative school network at Delhi
The Faraizi revolutionary council at East Bengal
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1927, the Muslim League split over the Simon Commission issue. The majority faction led by Mohammad Ali Jinnah met at Calcutta and resolved to boycott the commission, while a conservative faction under Muhammad Shafi met at Lahore to support the government.

qe: The Simon Commission landed at Bombay on February 3, 1928, facing nationwide black flag demonstrations and 'Simon Go Back' slogans. Which two young leaders emerged at the forefront of this new wave of youth and student mobilization?
qh: साइमन कमीशन 3 फरवरी, 1928 को बॉम्बे पहुंचा, जिसे देशव्यापी काले झंडे के प्रदर्शनों और 'साइमन गो बैक' के नारों का सामना करना पड़ा। युवा और छात्र लामबंदी की इस नई लहर में कौन से दो युवा नेता सबसे आगे उभरे?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru and Subhash Chandra Bose
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and Rajendra Prasad
C. Rajagopalachari and M.A. Ansari
Lala Lajpat Rai and Madan Mohan Malaviya
e: Detailed Explanation: The anti-Simon upsurge energized a new generation of youth. Jawaharlal Nehru and Subhash Chandra Bose emerged as the prominent leaders of this radical student wave, traveling extensively to organize militant protest leagues across the country.

qe: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was appointed by the Bombay Legislative Council to work with the Simon Commission. When he went before the commission in October 1928, what radical constitutional rights did he demand for all citizens?
qh: डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर को बॉम्बे विधान परिषद द्वारा साइमन कमीशन के साथ काम करने के लिए नियुक्त किया गया था। जब वे अक्टूबर 1928 में आयोग के सामने गए, तो उन्होंने सभी नागरिकों के लिए किन क्रांतिकारी संवैधानिक अधिकारों की मांग की?
o: Universal adult franchise for both males and females alike, provincial autonomy, and dyarchy at the Center
Separate electorates based strictly on hereditary caste Pure purity lines for high-caste Hindus
The complete legislative termination of the bicameral Central Legislative Assembly
Restricting voting franchise exclusively to landowners who paid a cash revenue surcharge
e: Detailed Explanation: Before the Simon Commission in October 1928, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar made a highly progressive demand for 'universal adult franchise' for men and women alike, a right that was not yet guaranteed in most contemporary European nations, along with provincial autonomy.

qe: On behalf of the Bahishkrita Hitakarini Sabha, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar submitted a detailed memorandum to the Simon Commission. What was his central assertion regarding the socio-political status of the Depressed Classes?
qh: बहिष्कृत हितकारिणी सभा की ओर से, डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने साइमन कमीशन को एक विस्तृत ज्ञापन सौंपा। दलित वर्गों (Depressed Classes) की सामाजिक-राजनीतिक स्थिति के संबंध में उनका मुख्य दावा क्या था?
o: There was no link between the depressed classes and the Hindu community, and they should be regarded as a distinct and independent minority
They formed an un-splintered, identical religious block with orthodox upper-caste Brahmins
They possessed absolute land ownership rights over 100% of the Permanent Settlement tracts
They required the mandatory implementation of Sanskritic education frameworks inside rural subdivisions
e: Detailed Explanation: Dr. Ambedkar's memorandum asserted that the Depressed Classes had no organic socio-religious link with the mainstream Hindu community and should be legally treated as a distinct, independent minority requiring specific political safeguards.

qe: What specific political protection guidelines did Dr. B.R. Ambedkar demand for the Depressed Classes if the colonial state refused to grant universal adult franchise?
qh: यदि औपनिवेशिक राज्य सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार देने से इनकार करता है, तो डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने दलित वर्गों के लिए किस विशिष्ट राजनीतिक सुरक्षा दिशानिर्देश की मांग की थी?
o: A campaign for a separate electorate for the depressed classes and representation on the same basis as the Mohammedan minority
The total legal abolition of any reserved seats inside the provincial assemblies
The complete administrative transfer of the district collector's magisterial powers to village elders
An absolute restriction barring lower-caste individuals from entering public services
e: Detailed Explanation: Ambedkar argued that due to social enslavement and economic poverty, the Depressed Classes needed greater protection than any other minority. He demanded representation equal to the Muslim minority: reserved seats if universal franchise was granted, or separate electorates if it was denied.

qe: The report published by the Simon Commission did grant reserved seats to the Depressed Classes, but what restrictive condition did it attach that highly displeased Dr. B.R. Ambedkar?
qh: साइमन कमीशन द्वारा प्रकाशित रिपोर्ट ने दलित वर्गों के लिए आरक्षित सीटें तो दीं, लेकिन उसने कौन सी प्रतिबंधात्मक शर्त जोड़ी जिससे डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर अत्यधिक असंतुष्ट हुए?
o: Candidates who would take part in the elections would have to get their competence endorsed by the provincial Governor first
All lower-caste candidates were legally forced to undergo specialized military arsenal testing examinations in English
The seats were restricted exclusively to those who paid a heavy land revenue tax surcharge directly to London
The elected representatives were barred from asking any supplementary budget questions inside the council rooms
e: Detailed Explanation: Although the Simon Commission report allocated reserved seats to the Depressed Classes, it watered down the concession by requiring candidates to get a certificate of competence endorsed by the British Governor, which Ambedkar strongly opposed.

qe: The widespread youth upsurge against the Simon Commission provided a fertile ground for the germination of radical socialist ideas. Which of the following radical organizations emerged or spread during this phase?
qh: साइमन कमीशन के खिलाफ व्यापक युवा उभार ने कट्टरपंथी समाजवादी विचारों के प्रसार के लिए एक उपजाऊ जमीन प्रदान की। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कट्टरपंथी संगठन इस चरण के दौरान उभरा या फैला?
o: Punjab Naujawan Bharat Sabha, Workers' and Peasants' Parties, and Hindustani Sewa Dal (Karnataka)
Atmiya Sabha, Dharma Sabha, and the Tattvabodhini Sabha core platforms
The Ladies Social Conference and the All India Women’s Conference branches
The Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company and the Satyashodhak Labour Front
e: Detailed Explanation: The mass anti-Simon protests catalyzed socialist groups across multiple regions, leading directly to the expansion and prominence of groups like the Punjab Naujawan Bharat Sabha, regional Workers' and Peasants' Parties, and the Hindustani Sewa Dal in Karnataka.

qe: During the intense police crackdowns on peaceful anti-Simon demonstrations, which iconic nationalist leader received severe, fatal blows to his chest in October 1928, leading to his tragic demise on November 17, 1828?
qh: साइमन-विरोधी शांतिपूर्ण प्रदर्शनों पर पुलिस की कड़ी कार्रवाई के दौरान, अक्टूबर 1928 में किस प्रतिष्ठित राष्ट्रवादी नेता के सीने पर गंभीर और घातक लाठियां लगीं, जिससे 17 नवंबर, 1928 को उनका दुखद निधन हो गया?
o: Lala Lajpat Rai
Govind Ballabh Pant
Jawaharlal Nehru
Bhagat Singh
e: Detailed Explanation: Lala Lajpat Rai (Sher-i-Punjab) led a peaceful anti-Simon procession in Lahore in October 1928. He was brutally assaulted during an unprovoked police lathi-charge, sustaining severe chest injuries that directly caused his death on November 17, 1928.

qe: The Simon Commission recommendations published in a two-volume report in May 1930 proposed a major structural change for provincial administration. What did it recommend regarding Dyarchy?
qh: मई 1930 में दो खंडों की रिपोर्ट में प्रकाशित साइमन कमीशन की सिफारिशों ने प्रांतीय प्रशासन के लिए एक बड़े संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन का प्रस्ताव दिया। द्वैध शासन (Dyarchy) के संबंध में इसने क्या सिफारिश की थी?
o: The complete abolition of dyarchy and the establishment of representative government and autonomy in the provinces
The structural consolidation of dyarchy by transferring law and order to bureaucratic executive councillors permanently
Subordinating all provincial transferred subjects directly to a special three-judge panel of the High Court
The total legal transfer of provincial revenue collection rights to the village caste elders
e: Detailed Explanation: The Simon Commission report recommended completely scraping the unworkable system of Dyarchy in the provinces. In its place, it proposed establishing representative governance, granting a form of provincial autonomy to the local administrations.

qe: Under the provincial autonomy model suggested by the Simon Commission, what overarching discretionary power was explicitly reserved for the British Governor?
qh: साइमन कमीशन द्वारा सुझाए गए प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता मॉडल के तहत, ब्रिटिश राज्यपाल के लिए कौन सी सर्वोपरि विवेकाधीन शक्ति (discretionary power) स्पष्ट रूप से सुरक्षित थी?
o: Discretionary powers in relation to internal security and administrative powers to protect different communities
The absolute right to independently print regional currencies without central tracking guidelines
The sovereign authority to appoint the Prime Minister of Great Britain independent of Parliament
Complete operational command over the logistical shipping lines operating along the western coast
e: Detailed Explanation: While recommending provincial autonomy, the Simon report inserted imperial safeguards. It recommended arming the Governor with wide discretionary powers over internal security and specialized administrative authority to protect minorities.

qe: What stance did the May 1930 Simon Commission report adopt regarding parliamentary responsibility and executive appointments at the central government level?
qh: मई 1930 की साइमन कमीशन की रिपोर्ट ने केंद्र सरकार के स्तर पर संसदीय जवाबदेही और कार्यकारी नियुक्तियों के संबंध में क्या रुख अपनाया?
o: It completely rejected parliamentary responsibility at the centre, giving the Governor-General absolute power to appoint cabinet members
It introduced a full responsible government framework with cabinet ministers answerable to the lower house majority
It mandated that at least half of the central executive council seats must be elected by village panchayats
It completely subordinated the executive authority of the Governor-General to the Federal Court benches
e: Detailed Explanation: The Simon Commission refused to grant democratic advance at the all-India level. It rejected any introduction of parliamentary responsibility at the center, ensuring the Governor-General retained autocratic control to select and appoint his cabinet.

qe: Regarding the judicial framework, what structural recommendation did the Simon Commission outline concerning the relationship between the Government of India and the higher judiciary?
qh: न्यायिक ढांचे के संबंध में, साइमन कमीशन ने भारत सरकार और उच्च न्यायपालिका के बीच संबंधों को लेकर कौन सा संरचनात्मक सुझाव दिया था?
o: The Government of India would have complete control over the High Court
The High Courts were to be made entirely independent and placed under the Privy Council exclusively
All High Court judicial decisions had to be cleared by the legislative council non-officials majority
The total legal abolition of any High Court infrastructure across Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras
e: Detailed Explanation: To centralize administrative grip, the Simon Commission report recommended that the colonial Government of India should exercise complete administrative control over the provincial High Courts.

qe: What recommendation did the Simon Commission report make regarding the retention of separate communal electorates and the expansion of mass franchise?
qh: साइमन कमीशन की रिपोर्ट ने पृथक सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों को बनाए रखने और जन मताधिकार के विस्तार के संबंध में क्या सिफारिश की थी?
o: Separate communal electorates should be retained and extended to other communities, and there was to be no universal franchise
Separate electorates were to be completely abolished in favor of universal adult suffrage for all men and women
Communal electorates were to be restricted strictly to wealthy urban zamindars who paid a cash income tax
The implementation of a separate electorate framework exclusively for the landless untouchable agricultural laborers
e: Detailed Explanation: The Simon report rejected Dr. Ambedkar's demand for democracy. It stated that separate communal electorates must be retained and extended to other communities until tensions died down, and it explicitly opposed introducing universal adult franchise.

qe: To manage the structural integration of the sub-continent, what transitional administrative entity did the Simon Commission suggest establishing to include both British provinces and princely states?
qh: उपमहाद्वीप के संरचनात्मक एकीकरण को प्रबंधित करने के लिए, साइमन कमीशन ने ब्रिटिश प्रांतों और रियासतों दोनों को शामिल करने के लिए किस संक्रमणकालीन प्रशासनिक इकाई की स्थापना का सुझाव दिया था?
o: A Consultative Council of Greater India
The Congress Working Committee alliance trust
The Federal Court Arbitration Assembly
The United States of South Asia corporate board
e: Detailed Explanation: The Simon Commission accepted the concept of federalism only as a distant goal. It suggested an intermediate step: creating a 'Consultative Council of Greater India' containing representatives from both the British-governed provinces and the native princely states.

qe: The Simon Commission recommended distinct territorial reorganizations for the western and northwestern boundaries of British India. Which of the following matches these recommendations?
qh: साइमन कमीशन ने ब्रिटिश भारत की पश्चिमी और उत्तर-पश्चिमी सीमाओं के लिए अलग-अलग क्षेत्रीय पुनर्गठन की सिफारिश की थी। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा इन सिफारिशों का मिलान करता है?
o: Sindh should be separated from Bombay, Burma separated from India, and legislatures set up in NWFP and Baluchistan
Bihar and Orissa should be completely merged back into the Bengal Presidency delta plains
The Punjab plains should be separated and appended directly to the Central Provinces administrative circle
The total administrative integration of the Kingdom of Nepal into the United Provinces layout
e: Detailed Explanation: The Simon report proposed key boundary adjustments: separating Sindh from the Bombay Presidency, separating Burma from British India completely (as it was not a natural part of the subcontinent), and granting local legislatures to the North-West Frontier Province (NWFP) and Baluchistan.

qe: As an answer to Lord Birkenhead’s arrogant challenge, an All Parties Conference met in February 1928 and appointed a sub-committee to draft a constitution. Who served as the Chairman of this historic sub-committee?
qh: लॉर्ड बर्कनहेड की अहंकारी चुनौती के जवाब में, फरवरी 1928 में एक सर्वदलीय सम्मेलन (All Parties Conference) बुलाकर एक संविधान का मसौदा तैयार करने के लिए एक उप-समिति नियुक्त की गई। इस ऐतिहासिक उप-समिति के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
o: Motilal Nehru
Jawaharlal Nehru
Tej Bahadur Sapru
Subhash Chandra Bose
e: Detailed Explanation: The challenge to produce an agreed constitution was accepted by Indian leaders. The All Parties Conference appointed a sub-committee chaired by Pandit Motilal Nehru to draft India's first indigenous constitutional framework, known as the Nehru Report.

qe: The members of the Motilal Nehru sub-committee drafted a comprehensive constitutional framework by August 1928. Which of the following sets represents the prominent members who worked on this committee?
qh: मोतीलाल नेहरू उप-समिति के सदस्यों ने अगस्त 1928 तक एक व्यापक संवैधानिक ढांचे का मसौदा तैयार किया। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सेट उन प्रमुख सदस्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जिन्होंने इस समिति में काम किया था?
o: Tej Bahadur Sapru, Subhash Bose, M.S. Aney, Mangal Singh, Ali Imam, Shuab Qureshi, and G.R. Pradhan
Mohammad Ali Jinnah, Muhammad Shafi, Nawab Salimullah, and the Agha Khan exclusively
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, Chimanlal Setalvad, Jagat Narayan, and Sultan Ahmad Khan
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, Narahari Parikh, Mohanlal Pandya, and Ravi Shankar Vyas
e: Detailed Explanation: The Nehru Committee was composed of a cross-section of political minds, including legal and political experts like Sir Tej Bahadur Sapru, Subhash Chandra Bose, M.S. Aney, Mangal Singh, Ali Imam, Shuab Qureshi, and G.R. Pradhan.

qe: The recommendations of the 1928 Nehru Committee were completely unanimous except for one critical baseline issue that created a division within the nationalist ranks. What was this issue?
qh: 1928 की नेहरू समिति की सिफारिशें एक महत्वपूर्ण बुनियादी मुद्दे को छोड़कर पूरी तरह से सर्वसम्मत थीं, जिसने राष्ट्रवादी रैंकों के भीतर एक विभाजन पैदा कर दिया था। यह मुद्दा क्या था?
o: The majority favored 'Dominion Status' as the basis of the Constitution, while a younger section demanded 'Complete Independence'
A fierce disagreement over whether to completely abolish the system of private land property in land
Whether to restrict the voting franchise exclusively to the high-caste educated Brahmins
The inclusion of English as the mandatory official language across all lower subdivision court rooms
e: Detailed Explanation: The main point of contention in the Nehru Report was the ultimate goal. The older majority section led by Motilal Nehru favored 'Dominion Status' within the empire, while a younger, radical section led by Jawaharlal Nehru and Subhash Bose vigorously demanded that 'Complete Independence' (Purna Swaraj) be the core basis.

qe: The historic 1928 Nehru Report restricted its immediate constitutional proposals strictly to British India, but it explicitly envisaged what future structural link-up with the native Princely States?
qh: ऐतिहासिक 1928 की नेहरू रिपोर्ट ने अपने तत्काल संवैधानिक प्रस्तावों को कड़ाई से ब्रिटिश भारत तक सीमित रखा, लेकिन इसने देशी रियासतों (Princely States) के साथ भविष्य के किस संरचनात्मक जुड़ाव की परिकल्पना की थी?
o: A link-up on a federal basis
A complete permanent military annexation layout
The total absolute structural integration into the Bengal presidency
An informal trading alliance channel managed by British managing agencies
e: Detailed Explanation: The Nehru Report looked toward an integrated future for the subcontinent, explicitly proposing that a free British India should link up with the native princely states on a comprehensive federal framework.

qe: The 1928 Nehru Report took a radical step by completely rejecting separate electorates. What alternative electoral system did it propose to safeguard minority representations?
qh: 1928 की नेहरू रिपोर्ट ने पृथक निर्वाचन मंडल को पूरी तरह से खारिज करके एक क्रांतिकारी कदम उठाया। अल्पसंख्यक प्रतिनिधित्व की रक्षा के लिए इसने कौन सी वैकल्पिक चुनावी प्रणाली प्रस्तावित की थी?
o: Joint electorates with reservation of seats for Muslims at the Centre and in provinces where they were in a minority
Separate communal electorates extended to all intermediate non-Brahmin caste configurations
An open universal adult franchise tracking system with zero reserved seats for any community
A class-based indirect electoral college managed exclusively by local village panchayats
e: Detailed Explanation: The Nehru Report rejected separate electorates as divisive. In their place, it demanded a system of joint electorates across India, supplemented by reservation of seats for Muslims at the center and in provinces where they formed a numerical minority (and not where they were in a majority, like Punjab or Bengal).

qe: How many 'Fundamental Rights' were explicitly outlined and demanded for citizens within the historic constitutional draft of the 1928 Nehru Report?
qh: 1928 की नेहरू रिपोर्ट के ऐतिहासिक संवैधानिक मसौदे के भीतर नागरिकों के लिए कितने 'मौलिक अधिकार' (Fundamental Rights) विशेष रूप से रेखांकित और मांगे गए थे?
o: Nineteen fundamental rights
Seven fundamental rights
Ten fundamental rights
Exactly twelve fundamental rights
e: Detailed Explanation: The Nehru Report featured a highly progressive charter of civil liberties, explicitly demanding exactly nineteen fundamental rights for citizens, including universal adult suffrage, the right to form trade unions, and equal rights for women.

qe: According to the structural blueprints of the Nehru Report, what was the proposed legislative composition for the central Indian Parliament?
qh: नेहरू रिपोर्ट के संरचनात्मक खाके के अनुसार, केंद्रीय भारतीय संसद के लिए प्रस्तावित विधायी संरचना क्या थी?
o: A bicameral arrangement consisting of a 500-member House of Representatives and a 200-member Senate
A unicameral Imperial Legislative Assembly composed of 145 elected members exclusively
A tiered Council of State featuring 60 members nominated directly by the British Crown
A centralized assembly where seats were allocated strictly based on the military importance of provinces
e: Detailed Explanation: The Nehru Report recommended a democratic bicameral parliament at the center: a lower house named the House of Representatives consisting of 500 members elected via adult suffrage, and an upper house named the Senate featuring 200 members elected by provincial councils.

qe: What operational tenure durations were fixed by the 1928 Nehru Committee for the proposed central House of Representatives and the Senate respectively?
qh: 1928 की नेहरू समिति द्वारा प्रस्तावित केंद्रीय प्रतिनिधि सभा (House of Representatives) और सीनेट के लिए क्रमशः कितनी परिचालन अवधि तय की गई थी?
o: 5 years for the House of Representatives and 7 years for the Senate
3 years for the House of Representatives and 5 years for the Senate
5 years for both houses concurrent with the central budget apresentação list
A permanent lifelong tenure for the Senate and 1 year for the lower house
e: Detailed Explanation: Under the legislative hierarchy designed in the Nehru Report, the lower chamber (House of Representatives) was assigned an operational tenure of 5 years, while the upper chamber (Senate) was given a tenure of 7 years.

qe: Under the executive model designed by the Nehru Committee, the central government was to be headed by a Governor-General. How was this office to be funded and directed?
qh: नेहरू समिति द्वारा तैयार किए गए कार्यकारी मॉडल के तहत, केंद्र सरकार का प्रमुख एक गवर्नर-जनरल होना था। इस कार्यालय को कैसे वित्तपोषित और निर्देशित किया जाना था?
o: Appointed by the British government but paid out of Indian revenues, acting strictly on the advice of a central executive council responsible to the Parliament
Handpicked by the Federal Court judges and paid out of the savings of the Tilak Swaraj Fund
Financed entirely by the British exchequer in London and possessing absolute sovereign veto powers
Selected directly by a majority vote of the village panchayats and unaccountable to the legislature
e: Detailed Explanation: The report maintained a constitutional link with Britain by stating that the Governor-General would be appointed by the Crown. However, he would be paid out of Indian revenues and was legally bound to act as a constitutional head, guided entirely by the advice of an executive council responsible to the elected Parliament.

qe: Regarding secularism, what explicit core principle did the 1928 Nehru Report incorporate to ensure equality among all religious communities?
qh: धर्मनिरपेक्षता के संबंध में, 1928 की नेहरू रिपोर्ट ने सभी धार्मिक समुदायों के बीच समानता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए किस स्पष्ट मुख्य सिद्धांत को शामिल किया था?
o: Complete dissociation of the State from religion
The mandatory declaration of Hinduism as the official state religion
The structural management of all mosque assets by the central council
Granting special legislative veto privileges to religious ulema bodies
e: Detailed Explanation: Anticipating the secular framework of modern India, the Nehru Report explicitly recommended the 'complete dissociation of the State from religion', ensuring the future government would remain completely neutral in matters of faith.

qe: In December 1927, a large group of Muslim leaders met in Delhi and formulated a charter of demands to be incorporated into the draft constitution, which were accepted by the Congress Madras session. What is this historic charter called?
qh: दिसंबर 1927 में, मुस्लिम नेताओं के एक बड़े समूह ने दिल्ली में मुलाकात की और मसौदा संविधान में शामिल किए जाने वाले मांगों का एक चार्टर तैयार किया, जिसे कांग्रेस के मद्रास सत्र ने स्वीकार कर लिया। इस ऐतिहासिक चार्टर को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: The Delhi Proposals
The Simla Memorandum
The Aligarh Concord
The Lucknow Resolution
e: Detailed Explanation: In December 1927, Muslim League leaders evolved a compromise charter known as the 'Delhi Proposals'. They agreed to surrender separate electorates in exchange for joint electorates with specific reservation caps for Muslims at the center and in majority provinces.

qe: Which of the following demands formed a core component of the historic 'Delhi Proposals' formulated by the Muslim League in December 1927?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मांग दिसंबर 1927 में मुस्लिम लीग द्वारा तैयार किए गए ऐतिहासिक 'दिल्ली प्रस्तावों' (Delhi Proposals) का एक मुख्य घटक था?
o: One-third representation to Muslims in the Central Legislative Assembly and the formation of three new Muslim-majority provinces
The immediate military annexation of the Kingdom of Nepal into the British territory
The complete operational closure of the newly established Dayal Singh College at Lahore
A total ban on lower-caste entry into public water bodies across the Bombay Presidency
e: Detailed Explanation: The Delhi Proposals laid down four key conditions: joint electorates with reserved seats, one-third representation for Muslims in the Central Assembly, representation in Punjab and Bengal proportional to population, and carving out three new Muslim-majority provinces: Sindh, Baluchistan, and the NWFP.

qe: A survey tracking path maps out a right-angled triangular layout from station O. A field vehicle drives 24 km North, and then turns to move 7 km East to reach target research checkpoint B. Find the absolute straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक अनुसंधान वाहन स्टेशन O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलता है, और फिर पूर्व की ओर 7 किमी जाकर अनुसंधान चेकपॉइंट B पर पहुँचता है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 25 km
31 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement sets up a classic right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs of 24 km and 7 km. The straight-line distance represents the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{576 + 49} = \sqrt{625} = \mathbf{25\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological ecosystem study tracking energy metrics, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of an alluvial biome is 44,000 units and the energy accumulated as Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 24,000 units, calculate the energy spent during plant metabolic respiration (R).
qh: ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक मैदानी बायोम की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 44,000 इकाइयाँ है और शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) के रूप में संचित ऊर्जा 24,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
68,000 units
30,000 units
18,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological productivity relationship formula: $NPP = GPP - R$, we isolate respiration losses: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the given variables: $R = 44,000 - 24,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: The All Parties Conference sub-committee finalized the historic Nehru Report in August 1928. What structural layout was designed for the provincial councils within this draft constitution?
qh: सर्वदलीय सम्मेलन की उप-समिति ने अगस्त 1928 में ऐतिहासिक नेहरू रिपोर्ट को अंतिम रूप दिया। इस मसौदा संविधान के भीतर प्रांतीय परिषदों के लिए कौन सा संरचनात्मक ढांचा तैयार किया गया था?
o: Provincial councils to have a 5-year tenure, headed by a Governor acting on the advice of a provincial executive council
Provincial legislative councils to be permanently abolished in favor of centralized central executive ordinances
The councils to be split on communal lines with separate electorates granted to all intermediate castes
The absolute subordination of all provincial administrative subject lists directly to the London British treasury
e: Detailed Explanation: For the provinces, the Nehru Report proposed a responsible governance model: local Provincial Councils would hold a fixed tenure of 5 years, and the provincial administration would be headed by a Governor who was bound to act on the advice of an executive council responsible to the local legislature.

qe: What macro-level shift occurred in the global strategic objectives of the British colonial authority in India during the late 19th century under the vice-royalties of Lytton, Dufferin, and Curzon?
qh: लॉर्ड लिटन, डफ़रिन और कर्ज़न के वायसराय काल के दौरान 19वीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध में भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक सत्ता के वैश्विक रणनीतिक उद्देश्यों में कौन सा बड़े पैमाने पर परिवर्तन आया था?
o: A renewed upsurge of tight imperial control and reactionary imperialist ideology to secure British economic interests against political dangers
The systematic progress toward granting absolute provincial autonomy to popular Indian portfolios
The complete financial dismantling of all high-cost British capital investments inside the railway lines
A total structural abandonment of the policy of 'divide and rule' across all provinces
e: Detailed Explanation: Facing severe cut-throat economic competition from new industrial powers like the USA and Japan, the late 19th-century British Viceroyalties (especially under Lytton and Curzon) adopted an intensely reactionary imperialist ideology. Their main concern was consolidating imperial control to protect British commercial investments (like railways and plantations) against rising nationalist political dangers.

qe: Under the financial decentralization scheme introduced by Lord Lytton in 1877, which specific provincial revenue tracking heads were transferred directly to the control of provincial governments?
qh: 1877 में लॉर्ड लिटन द्वारा शुरू की गई वित्तीय विकेंद्रीकरण योजना के तहत, कौन से विशिष्ट प्रांतीय राजस्व ट्रैकिंग प्रमुख सीधे प्रांतीय सरकारों के नियंत्रण में स्थानांतरित किए गए थे?
